## Acceptance criteria

1. **Earned connected progression.** Preparation → C01–C04 → paid in-place suit350 → Dart180 Basin approach → C05/C06/useful stock → return/storage/service works with existing costs, intended source habitats and useful margins. Earlier regions remain relevant; no inaccessible prerequisite, injected stock, required optional personal log or blueprint falsely presented as buildable. Account for optional trim and recovery reserves.
2. **Persistence and migration.** Schema3/expedition.4 strictly validates current data and historical closed domains before migration. Preserve valid old IDs, fitted instance/investment, stock, knowledge, poses and active recovery route; initialize new content once. Commands are immediately saveable; actual Continue preserves complete state and deterministic future. No decode teleport or widened arbitrary-ID acceptance.
3. **Local recoverable setback.** Basin staging/bench, Bobbin tether, tow/repair/salvage and cargo retrieval preserve the same disabled Dart/investment and discoveries. Starter-accessible rescue needs no advanced duplicate ship. Inspect interruption, route identity, actual active-operation reload, physical work faces and resource costs; distinguish real input from seeded recovery edges.
4. **World and source geometry.** Rendered terrain supports all 35 normal source/work views and four Basin endpoints while preserving legacy controls. Inspect cliffs/ledges, physical/render conformity, wall sweeps and old-contact escape. Static placement clearance has a disclosed historical footprint limit; judge concrete affected gameplay, not an assumed universal placement guarantee.
5. **Region lifecycle and cost.** Rendering activation is separate from persistent simulation, depletion and recovery. Bounded immutable geometry/sign reuse creates current state handles; rebuilding/quality/resize/context restore/disposal preserve identity and scene-owned materials. Review measured warm/cold costs and the unresolved composed 50.6ms/historical newer 59.3ms samples against the 50ms engineering trial. Do not silently waive them or equate SwiftShader/NullEngine with dedicated-GPU frame pacing.
6. **Readable shelter and counterplay.** Inspect actual level approach, living fork/descent attachment and physical rock shelter, then ordinary warning/investigation/true-cover escape and a separate quiet open-water escape. Preserve camera, source geometry and truthful cover classification. Coordinate assistance proves reachability/response, not fresh-human recognition. Assess whether the available visual evidence supports advancing this batch with that distinction.
7. **Hunter contact and withdrawal.** Shared rendered/contact dimensions, post-sweep mouth/skin/LOS and actual actor identity support visible approach, bounded separation and contact/withdrawal without inside bites. Parked/disabled/berthed hulls remain obstacles/LOS occluders after exit; real shell/lock/gap transforms apply. Inspect the conservative full-animation fleet envelope, overlap escape and possible excessive refusal. It intentionally is not exact animated triangle/triangle collision. Retain damage/noise/interest/exposure rates, meaningful danger, default player/vessel physics and the sixth movement callback. Check the optimized immutable query cache and required warm p95 ≤2ms CPU trial without presenting it as hardware certification.
8. **Truthful feedback and controls.** Bite versus collision accumulation, per-installed-step event processing, disable/recovery and queued speech priorities, pause/panel/import/Continue/context resets, muted/captions-off feedback, grounded-Dart warning/clearance and existing input/focus behavior remain coherent. No hunter trajectory or final health guess may relabel damage. No persistent UI state or per-tick live-region churn.
9. **Concise integrated presentation.** Actual preparation/refit, sources/notebook, useful return, recovery and dense hazard layouts at 960×600 and 1280×800 stay readable and actionable. Check native disabled reasons, keyboard focus/Return/Escape, local container intent and player-facing names. Honor the owner's request against subtitle/helper-paragraph overuse while retaining meaningful story/accessibility captions and essential errors. Assess richer-cel visual consistency and cockpit visibility using actual frames/sequences.
10. **Reproducible complete candidate.** Clean check/build and all three economies (M2 fresh and completed-earned) pass. The original full earned route plus source-attributed affected continuations must support the composed result. Evidence identifies ordinary, imported, staged and seeded cases; native-download losses, floating differences, hardware and human limits remain explicit. No placeholder-free full game, ten-hour duration or enjoyment claim follows from this gate.
